description:
intent=i029 snapshot=s03 branch=pull-return-unchecked status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/wan/hdlc_fr.c:889-979 confidence=medium conclusion=fr_rx() uses unchecked skb_pull(4/5) as a linearizer after only skb->len checks and keeps dereferencing data[3]/data[4] saved before skb_share_check, so a non-linear or shared received frame causes a stale-head read and reads of bytes not in the linear head (medium confidence).
unresolved location=net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c:7005 conclusion=Follow up: trace HCI transport RX skb allocation (drivers/bluetooth/* -> hci_acldata_packet) to decide whether a non-linear skb can reach l2cap_recv_frame; if yes, the lh->cid/lh->len reads after the unchecked skb_pull(L2CAP_HDR_SIZE) at l2cap_core.c:7005 touch bytes not in the linear head.
unresolved location=net/atm/pppoatm.c:201 conclusion=Follow up: determine whether ATM AAL5 RX skbs (net/atm/br2684.c:464, clip.c:224) can be non-linear; if so the post-pull memcmp(skb->data, pppllc, LLC_LEN) at net/atm/pppoatm.c:205 reads bytes beyond the linear head.
coverage_gap=The branch's prescribed open template dn_process_ack() (net/decnet/dn_nsp_in.c:130-158) does not exist in snapshots/s03 - net/decnet is absent - so the shape could only be matched by structure (len-check, unchecked pull, multi-byte read at new skb->data) against other stacks.
coverage_gap=Non-linearity preconditions for all reported and unresolved candidates were assessed structurally (which subsystems linearize before parsing) and not by tracing each hardware driver's RX skb allocation path (NFC, FRAD WAN drivers, HCI transports, ATM).
coverage_gap=No runtime reproducer, KASAN build, or compilation was performed against the read-only snapshot; every finding is a source-reading hypothesis without empirical confirmation.
coverage_gap=net/mac80211/rx.c pskb_pull sites (54/88/5380) and net/wireless/util.c (590/669) were name-triaged but not read in full, since prior facts f014/f022/f025 already cover mac80211 rx-path pull/stale-pointer defects in s03.
limitation=All three findings are source-reading hypotheses, not reproductions: no KASAN build, crafted frame, or running device was used; triggering each requires a non-linear (frag/fraglist-backed) skb at the parse point, and for hdlc_fr additionally a shared/cloned skb at skb_share_check.
limitation=Because no pskb_may_pull runs inside nfc_llcp_recv_agf or fr_rx, the concrete failure mode there is an out-of-bounds read of the linear head (bytes past skb_headlen, i.e. reading memory that belongs to frags) rather than the seed's pskb_may_pull-induced slab use-after-free; the branch treats both as the same missing-linear-guarantee invariant.
limitation=Reachability is config-gated: the NFC finding needs CONFIG_NFC plus an LLCP peer sending a crafted AGF PDU through a driver that does not linearize; hdlc_fr needs a Frame Relay WAN device; lapb needs CONFIG_LAPB/X.25. If every delivering path builds linear skbs, the code is fragile but not exploitable.
limitation=The lapb_subr.c finding is only a one-byte out-of-linear-head read of the second control byte, and its initial pskb_may_pull(skb,2) means the first byte is always safe; it is reported at low confidence for that reason.
limitation=The coarse scanner's heuristics (call line plus up to 8 following lines for dependent reads, 10 preceding lines for len checks) can misjoin multi-line calls or miss consumption in earlier lines, so a small number of false positives/negatives among the 70 flagged sites cannot be excluded.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque (no git history permitted), so it cannot be determined whether upstream has since fixed any reported site; line numbers are valid only for snapshots/s03 as supplied.
limitation=The seed location net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb (s03 pep.c:45-67, present and unpatched) was excluded from reporting per assignment rules, as was net/phonet generally.
